fnol_text: My name is Rafael Wojcik and I live at 492 Marigold Drive, Riverton, WY 82525. You can reach me on (555) 628-9370 or rafael.wojcik@example.com. On 16 November 2023 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Hiroshi Whitlock, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00015. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Wojcik on (555) 628-9370 to acknowledge the claim. Rafael confirmed the loss date as 16 November 2023.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Naomi Novak gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Hiroshi Whitlock reports a mild concussion and attended Riverside Medical Center. Rafael reports lacerations to the forearm.
